foldRule: Reuse v558 hit-object index parity: hit.index % 2 == 0 -> odd, otherwise even
fitPopulation: Only clear/approximate labels with an existing e1Full candidate and a finite absolute candidate error from the opposite fold of the same song
estimator: Unweighted median of signed absolute candidate errors (candidateAbsoluteMs - actualOnsetMs), numpy median convention
application: calibratedCandidateAbsoluteMs = candidateAbsoluteMs - oppositeFoldCorrectionMs; calibratedErrorMs = originalAbsoluteErrorMs - oppositeFoldCorrectionMs
candidateSelection: Frozen v558 e1Full candidate and residual; no re-picking, no new candidates, no audio or model inference
primaryMetric: Population-weighted clear+approximate +/-5 ms correct rate using absolute candidate time
guardrailMetric: noClearCandidateOutputRate must remain identical because calibration cannot add or remove candidates

hypotheses.H1: Opposite-fold song-level median delay correction improves population-weighted audible +/-5 ms correct rate over e1Full
hypotheses.H2: Calibration fixes more population-weighted baseline errors than it breaks baseline-correct objects, without reducing sample-044 audible correct rate below 80%
hypotheses.H3: Every fitted correction uses only opposite-fold labels and every metric can be independently reconstructed from absolute candidate times

testPolicy: Exactly one song-level unweighted-median rule; no per-segment fitting, clipping, weighted median, threshold tuning or same-fold fitting in v563
confirmationSetPolicy: Do not read confirmation audio, candidates or labels; development crossfit results are not independent confirmation
